verdict.rationale: LangSmith documents a self-hosted edition that runs in your own infrastructure so trace and operational data stay in your environment, which lets you control residency. The evidence does not show any choice of region for the managed cloud service. missing for 10: documented managed-cloud region selection (e.g. US/EU data regions), explicit data-residency or compliance documentation, independent corroboration of residency controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Self-hosted LangSmith runs the LangSmith platform in your own infrastructure so that trace and operational data stay in your environment.
Host an instance of LangSmith in your own infrastructure for observability, evaluation, and prompt engineering.
